title: The task
cards: Conditions
spell and say first
no web pages
everything inside the Claude app

steps.t: Here is the task I was given.
This box on the left is your Android phone, with the Claude app inside it.
You want the app to speak to you in the Adjutant voice.
These three tags are the three things you named.
This one is voice mode through the Adjutant effect.
This one is spell, which rewords the reply and speaks it.
And this one is say, which speaks the text exactly as written.
Your conditions are listed on the right.
Spell and say come first, with no web pages, and everything inside the app.

title: Where is the sound made?
cards: laptop: code runs here, speakers here ✓
phone: the Claude app runs no code ✗
Claude's code runs in Anthropic's sandbox

steps.t: The main problem is where the sound is made.
This box on the right is your laptop.
There, the speaker program runs on your own computer, and plays on your speakers.
The phone is different.
The Claude app runs no code on the phone itself.
This large box in the middle is a sandbox on Anthropic's computers.
That is where Claude's code runs.
So the sound must be made there, and sent back into the chat.

title: The main route
cards: spell: reworded by the clear-speech rules
say: the text as written
say.js --out reply.wav --no-play
the file plays in the chat

steps.t: This is the route I recommend.
You type spell or say in the Claude app.
The request goes to this box, which is a skill on your claude account.
These two boxes are the two commands.
For spell, Claude rewords the text with the clear speech rules.
For say, Claude keeps the text as it is.
This box is the same speaker program as on your laptop.
It writes a sound file, which is this box.
The file comes back into the chat, and you play it here.

title: What the speaker needs
cards: say.js: 124 KB, exists ✓
packages from npm: approved site ✓
voice model, 78 MB, Hugging Face: not on the list ?

steps.t: These are the parts the speaker program needs.
The program itself is small, and it already exists.
This box is the package manager site.
The sandbox is allowed to reach it, so it has a check mark.
This box is the Hugging Face site, which holds the voice model.
The model is about eighty megabytes.
That site is not on the approved list, so the download may be refused.

title: A fallback for each unknown
cards: skills not in the Android app → a claude.ai Project holds the files
Hugging Face refused → model on GitHub, or packed in the skill
file does not play → a small player inside the reply
neither plays → this route is closed

steps.t: Each open part has a fallback.
They are listed on the right.
Uploaded skills may not work in the Android app.
Then a claude project, this dashed box, can hold the same files.
If Hugging Face is refused, the model can come from GitHub, which is this box.
It could also be packed inside the skill.
If the app does not play the sound file, Claude can put a small player inside its reply.
That is this button in the chat.
If neither plays inside the app, this route is closed.

title: The delay
cards: first reply in a chat: about 30 to 60 seconds
set up the sandbox, install packages, load the model, make the sound

steps.t: Each reply also takes time to prepare.
This clock shows the cost.
The first reply in a chat may take thirty seconds to one minute.

title: Routes ruled out
cards: Remote Control: the sound plays from the laptop ✗
voice page in the phone browser: a web page ✗
own voice chat: a web page, with its own bill ✗

steps.t: I also looked at other routes, and these are the ones I ruled out.
This arrow is Remote Control, from the phone to your laptop.
It works, but the sound plays from the laptop.
This box is your voice page, in the phone browser.
It also works, but you asked for no web pages.
A separate voice chat of our own would also be a web page, with its own bill.

title: Voice mode, later
cards: JamesDSP: effects on other apps' sound (Android)
our effect as a Liveprog script
unknown: can it reach Claude's voice?

steps.t: Voice mode comes later.
This box inside the phone is an Android sound effect app, called James D S P.
It can change the sound of other apps, on the way to this speaker.
It could put the Adjutant effect on the Claude app's own voice.
So you would stay inside the app.
It is not yet known whether it can reach Claude's voice.

title: Next step: one test on the phone
cards: ☐ package site reachable
☐ Hugging Face reachable
☐ beep plays from a file
☐ beep plays from a player in the reply
☐ Skills under Settings → Capabilities

steps.t: The next step is one test in the Claude app on your phone.
The message to paste is in the chat on screen.
It checks these two download sites.
Then it plays a short beep from a file, and from a player in the reply.
These are the five checks, on the right.
Please also check whether skills appear in the app settings, under capabilities.
End of briefing.
